scope: Legitimate full-text discovery for Yajun Li, JOSA A 32, 877-885 (2015), DOI 10.1364/JOSAA.32.000877. Read-only; no login, payment, author contact, shadow library or paywall circumvention.
classification_comparison_limit: The abstract constructs electromagnetic LG-correlated Schell-model sources and propagation expressions. It does not itself state C8's arbitrary four-coherent-LG-mode PSD covariance classification. The uninspected full text could contain additional relevant results and has not been excluded.

routes.route: Publisher through a normal fresh Chromium tab
routes.result: Article identified, abstract accessible, full text explicitly subscription/pay-per-view restricted.
routes.observed_quote: To view this article you will need to login or make a payment.

routes.route: Google Scholar All 4 versions, read in normal Chromium
routes.result: One publisher PDF link, which reaches the subscription page; other versions are metadata/abstract records.

routes.route: Internet Archive Scholar/Fatcat current v2 API and public release/work pages
routes.result: Public release says Not Preserved. A 3697374-byte PDF metadata/hash record exists, but its URL list is empty. No webcaptures; fulltext lookup HTTP 404. Work page lists only this published version. No file was obtained or inferred from a bare hash.
routes.web_search_boundary: The Scholar search UI displayed ALTCHA. Its published guide linked the legitimate read-only Fatcat v2 API, which was used instead; no human-attestation checkbox was clicked. The legacy api.fatcat.wiki endpoint timed out and was replaced by the documented current API.

routes.route: CORE public API and search UI
routes.limitations: Two alternative quoted-title API queries returned HTTP 500; web UI remained behind a security check. The zero result applies only to the successful DOI query, not all possible CORE searches.

routes.result: Public resolver led back to the publisher, not to an OA manuscript. Direct v2 API request without a contact-email parameter returned HTTP 422; no false contact identity or private user email was supplied. OpenAlex's OA-location data is the usable OA metadata here.

queries: Laguerre-Gaussian functions Li repository manuscript preprint eprint
10.1364/JOSAA.32.000877 site:arxiv.org OR site:core.ac.uk OR site:archive.org OR site:edu
routes.result: No legitimate open manuscript found in the inspected results. OpenAlex lists a postal address, not an institutional affiliation. Its linked public ORCID works endpoint was empty; no independent author repository was identified. No author was contacted.
routes.limit: Search failure does not prove that no authorized copy exists.

conclusion: Li full-text comparison remains inaccessible under the permitted routes. This record supports an access limitation, not a claim that the paper cannot settle C8 or that C8 was historically open.
